title: An integrated diffusion-weighted imaging processing and interpretation platform for MR-guided radiotherapy
abstract: arXiv:2608.20519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Magnetic resonance imaging-guided linear accelerators (MR-Linacs) allow diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) to be acquired at every treatment fraction, but converting these low-signal-to-noise-ratio acquisitions into clinical decisions requires both reliable quantitative processing and an interpretation that reconciles a scattered and often contradictory literature.   Purpose: To describe and evaluate an integrated, web-based platform that carries raw MR-Linac DWI to a structured, literature-grounded clinical interpretation, and to assess its retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) interpretation module by independent expert rating.   Methods: The platform couples a deep-learning processing pipeline, comprising distortion correction, denoising, and intravoxel incoherent motion (IVIM)/apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) fitting, with longitudinal region-of-interest analysis and a RAG interpretation agent. translated_title: 用于磁共振引导放疗的集成弥散加权成像处理与解释平台
translated_abstract: 摘要：磁共振成像引导直线加速器（MR-Linacs）允许在每次治疗分次中采集弥散加权成像（DWI），但将这些低信噪比采集转换为临床决策需要可靠的数量处理，以及一种能够调和分散且常相互矛盾的文献的解释。目的：描述并评估一个集成的、基于网络的平台，该平台将原始MR-Linac DWI数据转化为结构化、基于文献的临床解释，并通过独立专家评级评估其检索增强生成（RAG）解释模块。方法：该平台结合了深度学习处理流程，包括畸变校正、去噪和体素内不相干运动（IVIM）/表观弥散系数（ADC）拟合，以及纵向感兴趣区域分析和RAG解释代理。该代理在文献基础上进行推理。
tldr: 该论文介绍了一个集成平台，将深度学习DWI处理与基于文献检索增强生成的临床解释相结合，为MR引导放疗提供标准化决策支持。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an integrated platform that combines deep-learning DWI processing with literature-based retrieval-augmented generation for standardized clinical interpretation in MR-guided radiotherapy.
